Bread baked before the town wakes

Slow sourdough from a small bakery on Hollin Lane.

Find the shop

What we bake

We bake in small batches. Every loaf is shaped by hand and proved for a day and a night, so the crust crackles and the crumb stays open.

  • Country sourdough
  • Seeded rye
  • Cardamom buns on Saturdays

Before the sun is up

Our ovens are lit at three. By seven the shelves are full and the door is open.
